**STEP 1 - Scene:** A plated mixed meal: a leafy green salad on one side, and on the other a portion of lentils with pale root vegetable chunks, green beans and zucchini. The food is moderate, roughly a side-plate-to-dinner-plate portion, with the plate about half covered.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square-ish dinner plate, about 26 cm across, with area about 530 cm². It fills most of the frame, and food covers roughly half of it.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Mixed salad leaves (lettuce, frisée/endive shreds, dark leaves), with a little light dressing sheen
- Green beans
- Cooked lentils with diced vegetables and some red pepper flecks
- Pale cooked root or potato chunks
- Zucchini/courgette pieces
- Dressing or oil (only a faint sheen, so small)

**STEP 4 - Volume:**
- Salad leaves: ~30% of plate, ~160 cm², airy, average height ~0.6 cm → ~95 ml
- Green beans: ~8%, ~40 cm², ~0.8 cm → ~30 ml
- Lentil mix: ~12%, ~65 cm², ~1.2 cm → ~78 ml
- Pale root chunks: ~5%, ~25 cm², ~1 cm → ~25 ml
- Zucchini: ~2%, ~10 cm², ~0.8 cm → ~8 ml
- Dressing: a thin film, ~5 ml

**STEP 5 - Grams** (density used):
- Leaves at 0.15 g/ml → ~45 g
- Beans at 0.6 g/ml → ~20 g
- Lentils at 0.9 g/ml (cooked, dense) → ~65 g, trimmed to ~60 g for the vegetable share
- Root chunks at 0.6 g/ml → ~15 g
- Zucchini at 0.5 g/ml → ~10 g
- Dressing ~5 g

**STEP 6 - Energy** (kcal/100 g as plated):
- Mixed leaves ~20; beans ~31; cooked lentils ~116; cooked root ~60; zucchini ~17; vinaigrette ~350 (oil-based, so per gram it is high)

Approximate total: ~115 kcal, with lentils providing most of it.

**STEP 7 - Uncertainty:**
- Leaves: 25–70 g (likely 45)
- Beans: 10–35 g (likely 20)
- Lentils: 35–90 g (likely 60)
- Root chunks: 8–25 g (likely 15)
- Zucchini: 4–15 g (likely 10)
- Dressing: 2–10 g (likely 5)

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A total of about 155 g (range roughly 90–240 g) fits a half-covered dinner plate of mostly leaves and a modest lentil portion. The leaves are airy, so their weight stays moderate. The estimate is plausible, so no adjustment is needed.
